name: EPSA
description: Knowledge artifacts of method project D7 (EPSA): the protocol-dimension grid over VisDrone and AI-TOD (15 tags × 34 protocol arms, plus three re-exported candidate budgets), literature-protocol reconstructions built from the archived official DOTA and VisDrone evaluation code, and EPSA-MRS together with its machine checker. All numbers in the package are rendered from the deposited artifacts, not transcribed. Funding: 2026 Annual District-level Scientific Research Project of the Science and Technology Bureau of Yongchuan District, Chongqing (Grant No. 2026yc-cxfzgy10101).
